description: This file defines a generic interface IReadRepository<T> for the application core, extending from IReadRepositoryBase<T>. It specifies that T must be a class implementing IAggregateRoot, serving as a contract for read-only data access repositories.

classes.description: A generic interface for read-only repositories, extending IReadRepositoryBase<T> with a constraint that T must be a class implementing IAggregateRoot.
